sections.history: Kachanam, whose Tevaram name is Tirukkaichinam, lies about 18 km from Tiruvarur and 9 km from Thiruthuraipoondi, in Tiruvarur district. It is a Paadal Petra Sthalam, hymned in the Tevaram by Tirugnana Sambandar, counted among the Shiva shrines on the southern bank of the Kaveri. The stone temple is of the Chola period and later.
sections.architecture: A Dravidian delta temple, the shrine enshrines Kaichineswarar — also Kaichina Nathar — in the sanctum, worshipped in a swayambhu, self-manifest lingam, with the goddess Palvalai Nayaki in her own shrine, a Nandi and the parivara devatas. The sthala vriksham is the kongu ilavam (silk-cotton), and the sacred tank is the Indira (Vajra) Theertham.
sections.legends: The lord is a swayambhu, self-manifest from the earth, worshipped as Kaichineswarar; the sacred tank's name, Indira or Vajra Theertham, links the place to Indra, who by tradition worshipped here. The goddess Palvalai Nayaki stands beside him. As with many smaller delta shrines, the fuller sthala purana survives chiefly in local tradition and Sambandar's verses.
sections.festivals: The temple observes Maha Shivaratri in Masi (February–March), Navaratri in Purattasi (September–October) and the Mondays of Karthikai, with Pradosha worship, at the quiet scale of a village shrine. Pilgrims on the Paadal Petra trail of the southern delta include Kachanam among their stops.
sections.experience: At Kachanam the pilgrim comes to a quiet shrine of the self-manifest lord. Before Kaichineswarar and Palvalai Nayaki, beside the Indira Theertham, the visitor finds the unhurried grace of a Tevaram temple of the southern Kaveri country, firm in the lingam that rose of itself from the earth.

visit.timings: Typically open from early morning to midday and again from late afternoon into the evening; confirm timings locally, especially on festival days.
visit.dressCode: Modest traditional attire is expected, with shoulders and knees covered; footwear is left at the entrance.
visit.photography: Photography is generally allowed in the outer corridors but not inside the sanctum; ask temple staff before photographing rituals.
visit.gettingThere: Kachanam is about 18 km from Tiruvarur and 9 km from Thiruthuraipoondi, in Tiruvarur district. Tiruvarur and Thiruthuraipoondi are the nearest rail heads, with buses and taxis to the village.
